Package com.cg.training.dao

Interface MemberDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
MemberDAOImplementation
public interface MemberDAO
MemberDAO is a Data Access Object interface for managing operations related to Member entities, such as adding a member, finding a member by ID, and retrieving all members.

Implementations of this interface handle persistence and retrieval logic for Member records in the system.

Author:
Jayashree Roy

    • addMember

      void addMember(Member member)
      Adds a new Member to the data source.
      Parameters:
      member - the Member object to be added; must not be null
      Throws:

    • findMemberById

      Optional<Member> findMemberById(String id)
      Finds and retrieves a Member from the data source by their unique ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the member; must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the found Member, or empty if no member with the given ID exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is null or empty

    • getAllMembers

      List<Member> getAllMembers()
      Retrieves all Members from the data source.
